Alex / Sara — thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap from our side:

- Goal: validate if Redwood can meet Acme's latency and cost requirements for realtime product recommendations, plus review data handling for PII-sensitive logs.
- Qualification notes: primary workload is 1k qps peak, 200ms target p95, logs need to be retained for 90 days. Security team will want SOC2 + KMS details.

Next step: a 45-minute demo + technical deep dive where Rishi (SE) will walk performance benchmarks and deployment options, and Dylan will cover integration/connectors. Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Aug 4, 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Thu Aug 5, 11:00–11:45 AM PT
- Fri Aug 6, 9:00–9:45 AM PT

Can you confirm which of the above works or suggest alternatives? Also please confirm attendee list (we typically include SE, infra/security, and product). I attached a short Discovery-Deck to share ahead of the call.

Agenda (tentative): 1) 15m product demo 2) 25m technical deep dive 3) 5m next steps

Thanks — I can send calendar invites as soon as you confirm a slot and attendees.

Best,
